title: Concept: .NET exception detail returned to a client
description: A .NET exception type with its stack trace in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The trace names the assembly, the namespace and the method, which maps the server-side structure of an application whose source an attacker would otherwise never see.
applicability: Deployments that render a .NET exception type with its stack trace into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The trace names the assembly, the namespace and the method, which maps the server-side structure of an application whose source an attacker would otherwise never see.
